portals.name: Flow Investor Portal

web.notes: Email and password login for funds, investments and documents. SSO and 2FA not mentioned on public pages; security page lists user account locking.

api.notes: Flow Customer API: REST with JWT bearer tokens issued on request via Support. Resources: Funds, Investors, Investments for the customer's organisation. Documents, capital calls, distributions and webhooks not documented. LP access not described.

terms.notes: Section 14 prohibits accessing the website by automated or non-human means, including bots and scripts. Section 6 allows account holders to grant access to designated representatives and third-party service providers.

portals.notes: Fund management platform for SPVs, VC, PE and real estate managers, law firms and fund administrators, now part of Apex Group. Modules: investor portal, automated capital calls, fund reporting, virtual data rooms, digital K-1 distribution. SOC 2 Type II. High confidence on API existence and auth (vendor docs, 2026-11-07); low on LP-side access.

assessments.rationale: Documented REST API with JWT tokens exists but is issued to the GP organisation on request and covers funds, investors and investments, not documents. LP side is a password web login. Terms prohibit bots, but explicitly allow delegated access to representatives and service providers.
